examShortTricks: Trick 1: The essay defines poverty through lived detail, not statistics — soap, hot water, rest, dignity; collect three concrete details for any theme answer.
Trick 2: The tone is angry and defiant — she rejects romantic and pitying definitions; tone questions need her own words as evidence.
Trick 3: Key insight: poverty is exhaustion and the loss of future options, not merely lack of money — state this redefinition.
practiceQuestions: Q. How does Parker define poverty? (2 marks) — not just lack of money but exhaustion, bad housing and lost hope/dignity.
Q. What is the tone of the essay? (1 mark) — bitter, defiant, personal.
keyPoints: Poverty defined through lived detail — smell, exhaustion, humiliation, not statistics.
Note the angry, defensive tone; she refuses pity and demands understanding.
